sections.text_helper: Section 36.4.4 "ADC slave interface (ADCITF)" in chapter 36 (Audio digital filter (ADF)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1716.
sections.section_content:
The ADCs are not always connected to the ADF. Refer to Section36.3 to check the situation
for this product.
The ADF allows the connection of up to two ADCs to the filter path. For the filter, the
DATSRC[1:0] bitfield in the ADF digital filer configuration register 0 (ADF_DFLT0CICR)
allows the application to select data from the ADCs.
Warning: The ADF does not support receiving interleaved data from
one of the ADCITF input.
